summary: Defines a TCP option that lets one end of a connection tell the other its user timeout, which is how long sent data may stay unacknowledged before the connection is forcibly closed. Normally that value is only local to each side, so sharing it lets peers coordinate.

eli5.summary: If you call a friend and hear nothing, you decide how long to wait before hanging up. This note lets each side of a TCP connection tell the other how long it is willing to wait.

questions: what is the tcp user timeout option
how long does tcp wait before closing a connection
